About me

About Me

Fülöp András
Product Designer (UI/UX)

Hi, I'm Fülöp András, a product designer based in Wiener Neudorf, Austria. I focus on solving real human problems through thoughtful, user-centered design.

My path to design is a little unconventional: I hold a degree in Physical Therapy from Babeș-Bolyai University in Cluj-Napoca, Romania — an experience that sharpened my ability to observe, listen, and empathize deeply with people. I've since channeled those skills into UX, completing the CareerFoundry Product Design program and building a new career around curiosity and craft.

I'm always learning and taking on new challenges. I'm currently building my first case studies and am open to junior product design roles where I can contribute quickly while continuing to grow.
